paite: Huan Judia gam a sawltak leh unau omte'n Zentelte'n leng Pathian thu agingta uh chih azata uhi.
heading: Peter In Athilhih Agum
english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

paite: Huchi in Peter, Jerusalem atuntouhtak in, zeksumte'n akiang ah,
english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

paite: "Zeksumloute inn ah lut in, akiang uah na ne," chi in akalhta uhi.
english: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

paite: Himahleh Peter in abul a kipan in kizom zel in akiang uah ahilhchian hi.
english: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

paite: "Joppa ah thum in ka om a, huan ihmu bang in ka om a, banghiam bawm, puan liantak bang aning li a kikhih, van a kipan khiaksuk bang in ka mu a; ka kiang ngeingei ahong tung hi.
english: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

paite: Huai tuh ka en kilkel a, ka ngaihtuah a, 'Lei a ganhing khe li nei leh gamsate chi chih, awm a kitholh ganhingte leh tungleng vasate ka mu hi.'
english: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

paite: Huan aw in, 'Peter, thou in; gou inla, ne in, hon chi in' ka za hi.
english: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

paite: Himahleh ke'n, 'Toupa, hilou e, siang lou leh nin bangmah ka kam ah alut ngei kei,' ka chi hi.
english: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

paite: Himahleh van a kipan aw in, anihveina in, 'Pathian in ahihsiangthousa nang siang lou chi ke'n,' chi in ahon dawng hi.
english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

paite: Huchibang ngen in thumvei ahong om a; huan bangkim van ah khaitouh in a-om nawnta hi.
english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

paite: Huan ngai in, mi thum Kaisaria a kipan ka kiang ah ahon sawl ua, ka omna inn kong ah ana dingh nilouh uhi.
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

paite: Huan Kha in kuamah khentuam nei lou a amau zui ding in ahon sawl hi. Hiai unau guk in leng ahon zui sam ua, huai mi inn ah ka lutta uhi.
english: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang uah, a-inn a angel kilak amuhdan leh angel in akiang a, Joppa ah mi sawl a, Simon Peter achih uh, pisak ding leh;
english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

paite: 'Ama'n thu ahon hilh ding a, huai mi thu in nang leh na inkuanpihte hotdam in na om ding uh' achihdan leng ahon hilh hi.
english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

paite: Huan thu ka gen patleh, achil a eite tung a ahong tun bang mah in, atung uah Kha Siangthou ahong tungta hi.
english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

paite: Toupa thu, Johan in tui in abaptis zel; himahleh nou zaw Kha Siangthou a baptis in na om ding uh achih ka hon theikhe nawn uhi.
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

paite: Huchi in Toupa Jesu Khrist i gintak ua, Pathian in thilthawnpiak ahon piak amaute kiang a apiak sam, kei Pathian sel vual ka hi a hia?" achi hi.
english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

paite: Huai thu azak un adaita ua, huchi ahihleh, "Pathian in Zentelte leng hing ding a kisik phalta ahi ve maw," chi in Pathian aphat uhi.
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

paite: Huan Stephen ziak a sawina thuak dalhzakte, Phoinisia gam, Kupra tuikulh leh Antiok khua pha in apai ua, Judate kiang kia ah lou ngal kuamah kiang ah thu agen kei uhi.
heading: Antiok Khua A Saptuamte
english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

paite: Himahleh alak ua akhen tuh Kupra tuikulh leh Kurini a mite ahi ua, huai mite'n Antiok khua atun un Grikte leng ahoupih ua, Toupa Jesu tanchinhoih ahilh samta uhi.
english: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

paite: Huan Toupa khut in amaute apanpih a; mi tampi in agingta ua, Toupa lam ahong nga chiatta uhi.
english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

paite: Huan atanchin thu uh Jerusalem a saptuam omte bil ah alutta a; huchi in Antiok kho pha in Barnabas asawlkhia uhi.
english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

paite: Amah ava tung a, Pathian hehpihdan amuh in akipak a, phatuamngaitak in Toupa len gige ding in avek un ahanthawn hi.
english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

paite: Barnabas mihoihtak ahi a, Kha Siangthou leh ginna a dim ahi. Huan Toupa kiang ah mi tampi a behlap in a-omta uhi.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

paite: Huan Saul zong ding in Tarsas ah Barnabas ahoh hi.
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

paite: Amuh in Antiok ah ahon pi hi. Huan kum khat hilhial saptuamte kikhopna ah apang zel ua, mi tampi leng thu ahilh uhi. Antiok ah ahi nungzuite, "Khristian," achih masakpen uh.
english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

paite: Huai lai in zawlnei kuahiam Jerusalem a kipan in Antiok ah ahohsuk hi.
english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

paite: Alak ua mi khat amin Agabas kichi adingh a, khovel tengteng ah kial thupitak atung dek chih Kha hilh in atheisak a; huai kial tuh Klaudias vaihawm lai in ahong tungta hi.
english: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

paite: Huchi in nungzuite'n atheihdan chiat un Judia gam a unau omte kiang ah panpihna khak atum uhi.
english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

paite: Huai tuh ahihta ngei uhi, Barnabas leh Saul khut ah upate kiang ah akhak uhi.
english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
